Area.evidence_source: [/page/11/Text/5] The empirical source of this study indicates that social demands and possibilities informed the ways in which the participants experienced and constructed masculinity, and thus influenced their suicidal behaviour. [/page/11/Text/5] As suicidal behaviour in this study seems to be receptive, reducing pain and create hope by being seen and confirmed in social relationships, and being helped to verbalise existential thoughts and openly discuss possible solutions, are of importance.
